description: AIF-01A capability contract: design challenge and exact-diff review

agent_can_widen_authority.instructions: Under this contract an agent or workflow could obtain authority beyond what a human-authorized grant gives it, register its own capability, or hold a human-only (A5) capability.

criteria.true: Some path lets an agent self-register, self-grant, hold A5, or widen tenant/branch scope
criteria.false: Registration needs a trusted authority, A5 is never granted to agents and scope can only narrow

secret_can_enter_contract.instructions: A raw secret, credential or token value could be stored in or pass through a capability definition, grant or invocation.

criteria.true: Some field can carry a plaintext secret that is not rejected
criteria.false: Only opaque credential references are accepted and secret-looking values are rejected

write_without_safety.instructions: A write capability can be admitted without an idempotency contract, a verification method, or with an observe/draft authority class.

criteria.true: A write can be admitted missing idempotency, verification, or with A0/A1
criteria.false: All three are enforced for every write

unknown_outcome_hidden.instructions: An external call whose outcome is unknown could be recorded as verified or successful.

criteria.true: UNKNOWN outcomes can be marked verified or successful

version_integrity_gap.instructions: A caller could execute against a capability definition different from the admitted one (changed content, other version, or mutated after admission).

criteria.true: Version, digest or immutability is not enforced somewhere
criteria.false: Immutable (id, version), content digest and digest check on lookup are all enforced

residual_risk.instructions: How much risk remains in this capability contract?
